summary: Bug: Work Orders list and Financial Info section show incorrect totals until Work Order is revisited or refreshed
reported_issue: Immediately after creating a WO (create WO -> create line -> request inventory part 'reteststage' qty 1 $19 -> Save & Close -> Finance tab), the total in the Finance tab differed from the total under the Financial Info section / Work Orders list; the totals only became correct after the WO was reopened or refreshed.
expected_after_fix: The Work Orders list, Financial Info section, and Finance tab all show the same total immediately, without needing a refresh.
steps_i_followed: Attempted to reproduce the exact flow (create WO + line + inventory part, then compare Finance vs Financial Info without refreshing) — blocked because work-orders/create and parts/create return HTTP 500 this session (documented create-endpoint quirk) and the New Line UI was intermittent, so a fresh WO could not be built to observe the pre-refresh transient.
Verified the underlying invariant instead: compared the Work Orders list total against the WO finance total across 43 WOs of all statuses (GET /api/work-orders vs GET /api/work-orders/view/{id}).
actual_now: All 43 sampled WOs show the list total exactly equal to the finance/financial-info total (0 mismatches). The persisted totals are fully consistent. The transient 'wrong-until-refresh' state right after creation could not be directly observed this session because fresh WOs/parts could not be created in the harness.
notes: Ticket is OBSOLETE, no fixVersion, and labeled Rejected_Staging (QA rejected the report as not valid/reproducible on staging). Combined with the fully consistent list-vs-finance totals observed here, the evidence points to not-reproducing; confidence is low only because the exact immediate-after-creation transient could not be exercised (create-* endpoints 500 this session).
